Class BlazeBitePaymentsTest

@IsTest()
private class BlazeBitePaymentsTest

Unit tests for the BlazeBitePayments DTO class. Validates deserialization of Firestore payment documents including payment fields, orders, refunds, checkout details, customer info, fees, and feedback structures.

Group:
    Data Transfer Objects (DTO)

Since:
    04/03/2021

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 04/03/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 04/11/2021 - v1.1 - Firestore fields use now the common classes in BlazeBiteTools.
  • 07/25/2021 - v1.2 - Tests refund data structure.
  • 03/28/2026 - v1.3 - Increase test coverage for checkout, fees, customer info, feedback, and newer payment fields.

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
emptyPaymentsTest()
Validates that null documents and null next-page token are handled gracefully, returning zero size and false for hasDocuments and hasNextPage.
private static void
nullFieldsTest()
Validates null-safe defaults when optional nested structures (checkout, fees, additionalInfo, orders, refunds, feedback) are null in the payment document.
private static void
paymentsTest()
Validates deserialization of a full payment document including core fields, orders, refunds, checkout details, fees, customer contact info, and feedback ratings.
